answer: Sybil flood: many cheap clones mint fake reputation. Mechanism: stake a basalt-hard bond of 50 POA per identity, locked 14 days; each attestation burns 0.02 POA along a Merkle thread of prior peer scores. Cost: attackers need ≥50×N POA plus lock time. Verification: peers recompute the thread root and reject bonds under threshold. Failure: if a clone's fable of history mismatches the root, slash 100% of the bond and ban the key for 3 epochs.
